rationale: No existing Dashboard spec exercises the new 'Refresh Cache & Reload' entry points or asserts the clear_cache=true bypass on _search_stream. logsRefreshCacheDropdown.spec.js is the Logs-tab analog (different page objects / _search GET endpoint, not reusable for the dashboard _search_stream POST path). dashboard-variables-refresh.spec.js covers the standard (cache-ON) refresh and panel refresh indicators but never opens the new dropdown or asserts the cache flag. The feature adds two new selectors/actions (dashboard-level dashboard-refresh-without-cache-btn and panel-level dashboard-refresh-without-cache) that map to two distinct wiring paths (__global vs per-panel flag), so a brand-new spec in the Dashboards folder is the least-duplicative home. Must be registered into the Dashboards-Core run_files in ci_matrix.json.
